ශී ලංකා පජාතාන්තික සමාජවාදී ජනරජෙය් ගැසට් පතය

THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7 My Ref. No.: DIVKB/LND/LA/DSKAQ/10. Land Min. Ref. No.:- 4-3/5/2019/HA/262. I hereby give notice, under Sub - section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the government intends to acquire the following land which is required for Divisional Secretariat Kobeigane:
Description of the land to be acquired:

The Allotment of land shown in the Cadastral Map No. 420722, Block No. 03 and Sheet No. 01 Dated 30.10.2023 Prepared by the Superintendent of Surveys of Kurunegala, in Extent of 0.4846 Hectare, situated in Ihala Aralugaswewa village in 1308 Aralugaswewa Grama Niladari Division in Divisional Secretary’s Division of Kobeigane in Kurunegala District in North Western Province. Lot No. 01 Name of the Land: Kahatagahamulahena and Kongahamulahena; Description of Land: Home Garden; Claimant : Land Reform Commission, Required for

Divisional Secretariat Kobeigane; Extent: 0.4846 Hectare. All persons interested in the aforesaid land to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing before me at Divisional Secretariat Kobeigane on the 22nd day of April 2024 at 10.00 am and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicates) on or before the 15th day of April 2024 the nature of their interests in the land the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount. W. Thilini Nisansala Silva, Divisional Secretary, Kobeigane. Divisional Secretariat, Kobeigane, 09th of February 2024. EOG 02-0109
